Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali Sonu Monu Lyrics
Sawa Lakh Haji Rukwa Ke Wakhra Mimber Banrawa Ke.

1
Dasiya Sab Nu Peygamber Takmeel Aye Deen Di Haider.
Islam Di Aye Tauqeer Aye Sab Wekhanr Wich Ghadeer.
Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali.
Rab Da Paigham Aye Aaya Jehra Pak Nabi Farmaya.

2
Islam Di Aye Tauqeer Aye Sab Wekhanr Wich Ghadeer.
Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali.
Ali Aaqa Ali Maula Ali Dastgeer Aye.
Waliyaan Da Wali Ali Peeraan Da Peer Aye.

3
Ali Pak Nabi Di Jan Aye Ali Zahra Da Eman Aye.
Ali Maula Nafs-e-Jali Aye Ali Warga Aap Ali.
Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali.
Narah Ali Da Sare Momina Di Shan Aye.

4
Ali Nu Na Jehra Manay Oh Be Eman Aye.
Haq Sach Di Aye Lalkar Aye Ali ALLAH Di Talwar Aye.
Maula Ali Shah-e-Mardaan Aye Maula Ali Shair-e-Yazdaan.
Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali.

5
Ohad Ich Chayi Jadon Maula Zulfiqar Aye.
Jang Fatha Ho Gayi Sari Kita Aisa Waar Aye.
Kul-e-Emaan Taig Chalai Kul Kufar Di Hoi Ruswai.
Qowat-e-Parwardigar Aye Ali Aye Haider Karar.

6
Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali.
Baad Nabi De Ali Shah-e-Lolaak Aye.
Chaday Jehra Ali Nu Ho Janda Halak Aye.
Jinna Qaul Nabi Da Bhulaya Rab Ohna Kolon V Manwaya.

7
Har Banda Ali Da Muhtaj Aye Ali Da Aye Do Jag Te Raaj.
Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali.
Haq Aye Ali De Naal Ali Haq Naal Aye.
Ali Agay Chaldi Nayi Kisay Di V Chaal Aye.

8
Haq Jehra Ali Da Khaway Oh Dozakh De Wich Jaway.
Aakhay Nabiyaan Da Sardar Aye Mere Haq Da Aye Haqdar.
Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali.
 Sonu Monu Te Asad Da Ayho Paigham Aye.

9
Ali Di Wilayat Wala Pe Lo Sare Jaam Aye.
Man Kuntu Maula Deen Aye Molaiyaan Da Yaqeen Aye.
Bakhshish Da Aye Doja Naam Aye Ayelan Karo Aye Aam.
Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali, Sachiyaan Da Peer Ali.

item.text:
Reconstructed **سچیاں دا پیر علی** in Shahmukhi Punjabi, preserving the opening verse, all nine stanzas, and the repeated refrains. Kept the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`, updated the script metadata, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I treated the opening title line as a heading and read the ambiguous Roman spellings “Banrawa” and “Wekhanr” as بنڑوا and ویکھݨ. All 37 verses align line for line.
